stories.title: Remove PortKiller docs outside docs/
acceptanceCriteria: rg PortKiller on repo root (excluding docs/) returns no matches in .md files except none
progress.txt and prd.json reference PortCheck only

stories.title: Rename project PortKiller → PortCheck
acceptanceCriteria: src/PortCheck/PortCheck.csproj and src/PortCheck.sln exist; src/PortKiller removed
All .cs/.xaml use namespace PortCheck; zero PortKiller in src/PortCheck
app.manifest and app.Debug.manifest use PortCheck.app identity

stories.title: Application icon and tray icon
acceptanceCriteria: TrayHost loads AppIcon.ico for TaskbarIcon (not procedural bitmap)
Published exe shows PortCheck icon in Explorer

stories.title: README and UI strings
acceptanceCriteria: README.md titles PortCheck with no PortKiller or upstream fork references
UI strings (tooltips, MessageBox titles, window Title) say PortCheck
rg PortKiller src/ returns zero matches

stories.title: Release build
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build -c Debug on src/PortCheck succeeds
dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 /p:PublishSingleFile=true outputs PortCheck.exe
publish folder contains PortCheck.exe and appsettings.json
